name: Hive 1.3.0
notes: Collaboration fix + composer features. Inviting teammates by GitHub handle now works reliably: signing in with GitHub (or configuring the relay afterward) registers you in the relay directory immediately, instead of only on the next app launch — so a friend who just signed in can be invited right away. Composer: image attachments now show an inline preview in the chat (not just a filename chip), and emoji are easy to add — a picker button plus inline :shortcode: autocomplete (type :fire: to get the emoji). Note: invite people by GitHub handle (it seals the workspace key and registers server-side membership); invite codes are for pairing your own devices.
